4647:
Tips for building your home:

⟨0⟩. Click a building in the building list to begin

⟨1⟩. A building's lock will open automatically once the requirements are met

⟨2⟩. Some buildings can have ⟨3⟩ or more

⟨4⟩. A building's level cannot exceed your home's level

⟨5⟩. The garden and the windmill are not only decorations, they also bring you abundant resources;

⟨6⟩. Click the edit button in the top right corner to edit. You can change the location of buildings in edit mode;

⟨7⟩. Besides buildings, you can also use decorations and scenery to fill your home with love.
4648:
Wall message tips :

⟨0⟩. You can check what other players have done at your home through wall messages;

⟨1⟩. Use Delete Message to delete a specific message, and delete all messages in the same category by using Delete List.
4649:

⟨3⟩. A certain amount of tax will be deducted from the reward when you complete another player's quest;

⟨4⟩. The number of your quests that can be published and the reward tax depend on the level of the quest board;

Warehouse tips:

⟨0⟩. The warehouse can be used to store farm produce and eggs.

⟨1⟩. The warehouse only has ⟨2⟩ initial slots. You can unlock other slots to get more space.

⟨3⟩. Visitor capacity and crop capacity by warehouse level:

Lv⟨4⟩: Can unlock ⟨5⟩ slots, harvest capacity ⟨6⟩.
Lv⟨7⟩： Lv⟨8⟩: Can unlock ⟨9⟩ slots, harvest capacity ⟨10⟩.

4651:
Pet raising tips :

⟨0⟩. You must feed your pet the type of food it needs, as listed in the menu;

⟨1⟩. If the same type of crop is placed in adjacent slots, you will get a fullness bonus:
⟨2⟩ slots: ⟨3⟩%
⟨4⟩ slots: ⟨5⟩%
⟨6⟩ slots: ⟨7⟩%
⟨8⟩ slots: ⟨9⟩%
⟨10⟩ slots: ⟨11⟩%
If you have ⟨12⟩ different food slots, you will still get a ⟨13⟩% bonus.
Each of your pet's favorite foods will earn a ⟨14⟩% fullness bonus;

⟨15⟩. Pet food can be obtained from Pet History, exploration, daily quests and the item mall;

⟨16⟩. When the pet is full, you can choose one of three skills to take and learn ⟨17⟩ skill;

⟨18⟩. If the skill slots are full, an old skill will be erased at random;

⟨19⟩. Click a skill icon to lock it so it won't be replaced, but it will cost one skill lock. Each skill costs a skill lock to lock, which can be purchased with Gold or Gift Coupon in the Item Mall.
4652:
Guidance Room tips:

⟨0⟩. When you reach Novice III in the arena and defeat an enemy whose level is above ⟨1⟩, you can take that player as your disciple in the Guidance Room.

⟨2⟩. If a player is already a teacher or a disciple, you cannot become a teacher.

⟨3⟩. Teaching or punishing a disciple will give you bonus EXP.

⟨4⟩. You will get bonus EXP from your disciple every ⟨5⟩ minutes. You will receive the EXP when the player stops being your disciple

⟨6⟩. If you are a disciple or a teacher, you will get bonus EXP from every act of help toward your disciple or teacher.

⟨7⟩. You can challenge your teacher or end your discipleship if you do not like your teacher.

⟨8⟩. You can only fight your teacher once a day.
